title.zh: Pump.fun Lets Creators Launch Coins Priced In Tokenized Stocks
title.en: Pump.fun Lets Creators Launch Coins Priced In Tokenized Stocks

current_state.zh: Pump.fun now allows creators to launch coins quoted in tokenized stocks like Nvidia, Tesla, and the S&P 500, with 93 pairs and half of revenue going to the PUMP buyback-and-burn contract.
current_state.en: Pump.fun now allows creators to launch coins quoted in tokenized stocks like Nvidia, Tesla, and the S&P 500, with 93 pairs and half of revenue going to the PUMP buyback-and-burn contract.
